# Revenue Enablement

> Revenue Enablement is a free MCP server and web app with twelve sales tools, by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting. Give it an account, a deal or a competitor, and it drafts account plans, deal strategy, discovery questions, ROI business cases, mutual action plans, win-loss reviews, proposal sections, emails, demo scripts, negotiation guides, champion kits and competitive traps.

- Web app (no sign-in): https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/
- MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only tools): https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/mcp
- Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf: https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/connect/
- Docs (MCP and REST, every field): https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/docs/
- FAQ: https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/faq/
- Privacy policy: https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/privacy/
- Local npm package: @shashwatgtmalpha/revenue-enablement-mcp
- Source code: https://github.com/shashwatgtm/revenue-enablement-mcp
- Built by: Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting (https://www.gtmexpert.com)
- All connectors and Claude plugins: https://tools.gtmhelix.com/

## Tools

- [Account Plan Builder](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/account-plan-builder/) (`account_plan_builder`): Generate strategic account plans with power mapping, whitespace analysis, and expansion strategies. Provides actionable 90-day plans based on account intelligence.
- [Deal Strategy Coach](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/deal-strategy-coach/) (`deal_strategy_coach`): Get deal-specific winning strategies based on deal stage, competitive dynamics, and stakeholder positions. Provides tactical next steps and risk mitigation.
- [Discovery Question Bank](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/discovery-question-bank/) (`discovery_question_bank`): Get contextual discovery questions using MEDDPICC, BANT, SPICED, or custom frameworks. Questions adapt based on what you already know about the prospect.
- [ROI Business Case Builder](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/roi-business-case-builder/) (`roi_business_case_builder`): Build an ROI business case template from your inputs: value, ROI and payback calculated with example assumptions and benchmarks that are labelled for you to replace, plus an executive summary.
- [Mutual Action Plan Generator](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/mutual-action-plan-generator/) (`mutual_action_plan_generator`): Generate collaborative close plans with milestones, owners, and dates. Creates alignment between buyer and seller on path to decision.
- [Win/Loss Analyzer](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/win-loss-analyzer/) (`win_loss_analyzer`): Structure a win/loss review of one deal or a set of deals: organizes the deal details you provide and returns the factors and questions to investigate.
- [Proposal Section Writer](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/proposal-section-writer/) (`proposal_section_writer`): Generate customized proposal sections tailored to specific buyers. Creates executive summaries, solution overviews, pricing justifications, and more.
- [Email Sequence Generator](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/email-sequence-generator/) (`email_sequence_generator`): Generate multi-touch email sequences by persona, stage, and objective. Creates prospecting, nurture, follow-up, and re-engagement sequences.
- [Demo Script Builder](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/demo-script-builder/) (`demo_script_builder`): Create outcome-focused demo scripts tailored to specific personas and use cases. Includes discovery questions, feature-to-value mapping, and objection handling.
- [Pricing Negotiation Guide](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/pricing-negotiation-guide/) (`pricing_negotiation_guide`): Get value-based pricing defense strategies and negotiation tactics. Helps maintain deal value while addressing discount requests.
- [Champion Enablement Kit](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/champion-enablement-kit/) (`champion_enablement_kit`): Create internal selling tools for your champion. Generates executive briefs, internal business cases, objection responses, and presentation talking points.
- [Competitive Trap Setter](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/competitive-trap-setter/) (`competitive_trap_setter`): Generate landmine questions and competitive positioning tactics. Helps expose competitor weaknesses during evaluation without being negative.

## Questions and answers

### What is Revenue Enablement?

Revenue Enablement is a free MCP server and web app with twelve sales tools, by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting. Give it an account, a deal or a competitor, and it drafts account plans, deal strategy, discovery questions, ROI business cases, mutual action plans, win-loss reviews, proposal sections, emails, demo scripts, negotiation guides, champion kits and competitive traps.

### Is Revenue Enablement free, and do I need an account?

It is free, and there is no account or sign-in. Use the tools in your browser here, or connect the MCP server to your AI assistant.

### Does it use AI to write the answers?

No. Each tool applies fixed rules in the Revenue Enablement code to the inputs you give it. It does not call an AI model and does not look anything up. When you use it from Claude or another assistant, that assistant writes around the tool's answer.

### What happens to what I type?

It is sent to this site's server, used once to build the answer, and dropped when the answer is sent back. Nothing is stored and nothing you type is logged. The privacy page has the details.

### How do I use Revenue Enablement in Claude?

In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors, select + and then Add custom connector. Name it Revenue Enablement, paste https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/mcp and choose no sign-in. The Connect page covers Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf too.

### Who built it?

Shashwat Ghosh, Co-Founder and Fractional CMO of Helix GTM Consulting, a business consulting firm founded in 2022 in Bengaluru. He has 24+ years in B2B and 10+ years of fractional experience, and created the EPIC, IMPACT and CRAFT frameworks and the Hub-Spoke Messaging Methodology.

### Why do some answers look like templates?

Several tools return a structured plan with [placeholders] where your inputs did not give a fact. When an answer shows a benchmark, target, rate, weight or other figure you did not supply, it is labelled "Example figure: replace with your own". Figures calculated from your inputs are not labelled. Suggested lengths, timings and counts are marked as suggestions. Replace every example and placeholder before you use the result.

### Can I call the tools from my own code?

Yes. Send POST https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/api/tools/<tool name> with a JSON body {"input": {...}}. The Docs page lists every field. Please keep to the rate limit of 30 requests per minute.

### Is the source code public?

Yes, at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/revenue-enablement-mcp under the MIT licence. The npm package @shashwatgtmalpha/revenue-enablement-mcp runs these tools locally; it can lag behind this site until a new version is published.

### Who is Revenue Enablement not ideal for?

Teams that want the tools to read their CRM, email or call notes: they work only from what you type. Sending anything straight to a buyer: every output is a draft for a person to review first. Teams that need saved deal history: nothing is stored, so keep each result in your own deal record.

### How do I report a problem?

Email shashwat@gtmhelix.com or open an issue at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/revenue-enablement-mcp/issues.
